meta.title: Family Manager (Demo)
meta.description: A household dashboard for tasks, appointments and rewards. Every family member gets their own WordPress account and their own view; administrators can open any member's view to check on it. Pre-loaded with a household of one parent and two children so you can explore right away (member accounts use the password "demo").
meta.author: Alex Kirk

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

if ( ! post_type_exists( 'family_household' ) || ! class_exists( '\\FamilyManager\\Storage' ) ) {
	return;
}

$admin = get_user_by( 'login', 'admin' );
$admin_id = $admin ? (int) $admin->ID : 1;
$storage = new \FamilyManager\Storage();

$household_id = $storage->create_household( 'Demo Household', $admin_id );
if ( ! $household_id ) {
	return;
}

$parent_id = $storage->add_member( $household_id, 'Sam', \FamilyManager\Access::ROLE_PARENT, '', 'demo' );
$mia_id    = $storage->add_member( $household_id, 'Mia', \FamilyManager\Access::ROLE_CHILD, '', 'demo' );
$ben_id    = $storage->add_member( $household_id, 'Ben', \FamilyManager\Access::ROLE_CHILD, '', 'demo' );

$storage->add_task( $household_id, 'Pack school bag', $mia_id, 'task', 5, gmdate( 'Y-m-d' ) );
$storage->add_task( $household_id, 'Feed the cat', $ben_id, 'task', 5, gmdate( 'Y-m-d' ) );
$storage->add_task( $household_id, 'Tidy room', $mia_id, 'task', 10, gmdate( 'Y-m-d', strtotime( '+1 day' ) ) );
$storage->add_task( $household_id, 'Dentist appointment', $ben_id, 'appointment', 0, gmdate( 'Y-m-d', strtotime( '+2 days' ) ) );
$storage->add_task( $household_id, 'Parent-teacher meeting', $parent_id, 'appointment', 0, gmdate( 'Y-m-d', strtotime( '+4 days' ) ) );
$storage->add_task( $household_id, 'Book summer camp', 0, 'task', 0, gmdate( 'Y-m-d', strtotime( '+10 days' ) ) );

$storage->add_reward( $household_id, 'Movie night pick', $mia_id, 20 );
$storage->add_reward( $household_id, 'Extra screen time', 0, 15 );
$storage->add_reward( $household_id, 'Ice cream outing', $ben_id, 25 );

$storage->add_points( $mia_id, 15 );
$storage->add_points( $ben_id, 5 );
